# GTD App - Project Summary

## Overview
A Laravel 13.x task management application for "Pengadilan Agama Medan" (Religious Court of Medan). Built with Laravel Breeze, Livewire 4.x, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS.

## Tech Stack
- **PHP 8.3+**, Laravel 13.8
- **Database**: MySQL (gtd_db)
- **Frontend**: Blade + Alpine.js + Tailwind CSS + Vite
- **Auth**: Laravel Breeze (Employee: NIP login, Admin: username login)
- **Queue**: Database driver
- **Mail**: SMTP (Gmail)
- **WhatsApp**: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (configurable driver: log/api)

## Core Models & Relationships
1. **Employee** (Authenticatable) - NIP-based login, hierarchical (superior_id → Position), has position_id, is_admin flag
2. **Task** - belongsTo Category, assignedTo (Employee), createdBy (Employee), status: Inbox/In Progress/Done, priority: Low/Medium/High
3. **Category** - hasMany Task, has icon/color/description
4. **Position** - hierarchical (many-to-many via position_parent), has level & sort_order
5. **Admin** - separate auth guard, username/password
6. **Conversation/Message** - individual/group chat between employees, with attachments

## Key Features
- **Task Management**: Kanban board (Inbox/In Progress/Done), create/assign/update/delete, due dates, priorities, categories
- **Hierarchy**: Employee → Position tree, superior/subordinate relationships, allSubordinates() recursive
- **Admin Panel**: Employees, Admins, Categories, Positions (with hierarchy), Performance, Analytics, Reports
- **Messenger**: Real-time-ish chat (polling 3s/15s), file attachments, email/WhatsApp notifications
- **Notifications**: Database notifications for task assignment/status updates
- **Daily Reminder Command**: `gtd:send-reminder` sends email/WhatsApp for pending/overdue tasks
- **WhatsApp Integration**: Log driver (default) or Meta Cloud API

## Routing Structure
- `/` → redirect to login
- `/dashboard` (Employee) → TaskController@index (kanban)
- `/tasks/*` → Task CRUD, manager dashboard, history
- `/messenger/*` → MessengerController (chat)
- `/admin/*` (auth:admin) → AdminController (dashboard, employees, admins, categories, positions, performance, analytics, reports)

## Database Key Tables
- employees (NIP, position_id, superior_id, is_admin, full profile fields)
- tasks (category_id, assigned_to, created_by, status, priority, due_date)
- categories, positions, position_parent (hierarchy)
- admins, conversations, conversation_participants, messages, message_attachments
- notifications (Laravel default)

## Views Structure
- `layouts/app.blade.php` - Employee layout with sidebar, notifications, hierarchy modal
- `layouts/admin.blade.php` - Admin layout with collapsible settings menu
- `tasks/index.blade.php` - Kanban board with modals
- `messenger/index.blade.php` - Alpine.js chat component
- `admin/*` - DataTables-based management pages with charts (Chart.js)
